facts.text: Rittman was named after Fred Rittman, treasurer of the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad, which ran a line through town in 1871.
Rittman is the only place in the United States named Rittman, making it unique among American cities.
A restored church off DeCourcey Road, maintained by the Rittman Historical Society, stands as a stately reminder of the area’s history.
Founded in 1975, the Rittman Historical Society operates a museum and research center that houses artifacts, documents, and photographs telling the city’s story.
Businesses grew around newly built train stations, and two factories became major employers as families settled and cleared trees for crops.
